description: Deterministic rewrite patterns for consumer-position cures in Rocq/Coq statement faces and proof bodies. Each pattern carries a deterministic trigger (regex, token-station, or face-scoped regex), a rewrite template, and is idempotent: running the applier twice changes nothing on the second run. Canonical shapes are mirrored from Set-carrier libraries (QeqT/Qeq bridges, qualified successor references, NatLe bridges). v1.1 adds ten statement-face patterns from the 20261103 wash-campaign field report: Qle/Qlt carrier-face downshifts (token and %-scoped notation forms), the refl bridge opener, Import-shadow direct-face qualification (two exclusive variants), and NatLe premise-lift / drop-wrap pairs. v1.2 adds the S07-lineage adaptation forms (W66 field report): parameterized-shell drop against an argument-less interface Class, the notation rebind line-insertion, the @field projection-bridge bare form, the predicate-face convergence token map (targets must be the consuming supply lemma's conclusion constant names), and a report-only binder-shell station for the manual binder surgery. v1.3 adds the two CI #178 extraction-defect families as cures: E3 generic-interface instantiation (the abstract-carrier application stations of a generic supply lemma are rewritten to a concrete-carrier specialization shim inserted after the last import) and E2 record polymorphic field (the un-annotated field-consumption Definition is restated as an explicit-type-annotated middleware, with the downstream arity stations adapted and a report-only station asserting the sweep completion).

patterns.title: rewrite-face bridge wrap (qeqT_imp_qeq, two explicit _ args)
patterns.canonical_note: Rewriting with a lemma whose conclusion lives on the QeqT face requires unwrapping to the eq face first; the sanctioned term form is rewrite (qeqT_imp_qeq _ _ (L args)). Direct term-form apply of the partially applied bridge is forbidden (elaboration solves _ _ as evars before the term unifies).
patterns.idempotence_note: The trigger skips terms already containing qeqT_imp_qeq, so the wrapped form never matches again.

patterns.title: goal-opening downshift (qeq_imp_qeqT before the ==-face proof)
patterns.canonical_note: When the goal is on the QeqT face and the available proof operates on the == face, open with apply qeq_imp_qeqT (gate-name reading: the second half names the goal face being produced).
patterns.context: only fires when the enclosing statement face contains QeqT
patterns.idempotence_note: After the cure the first tactic is apply qeq_imp_qeqT, which the trigger excludes.

patterns.title: opaque-reflexivity cure (apply Qeq_refl at door-opened == goals)
patterns.canonical_note: At a door-opened (apply qeq_imp_qeqT) == goal, the canonical reflexivity proof is apply Qeq_refl rather than bare reflexivity; bare reflexivity on the unopened QeqT face is opaque (the comparison match is stuck) and fails.
patterns.idempotence_note: Post-cure text contains apply Qeq_refl, not reflexivity, after the door.

patterns.title: qualified successor reference (bare S -> Datatypes.S at stations)
patterns.canonical_note: Where a record/class field or a local binder is named S, a bare global S reference resolves to the wrong object (field shadowing); the canonical form qualifies the successor constructor as Datatypes.S everywhere. Binder-bound references stay local and are never rewritten.
patterns.trigger: stations of scan_v4_token (classes shadow-hazard and unqualified-global)
patterns.idempotence_note: After qualification the tokens are dotted and no longer census stations.

patterns.title: Qle statement-face downshift (bare Qle -> QleT' in Theorem/Lemma/Proposition/Corollary/Instance faces)
patterns.canonical_note: Qle is the stdlib Prop-face order; the Set-carrier face is QleT' := Id (Qle_bool x y) true. The whole statement face is washed (premises and conclusion) per the campaign canonical: every Prop-face Qle in a washed file's statement face moves to QleT'. Faces already carrying QleT' (bridges like Qle_to_QleT'/QleT'_to_Qle, their consumers, cured faces) are excluded; binder declarations `(Qle : T)`, declared names, and `:=`-bound names are guarded by the trigger lookahead; Definition/Fixpoint faces are excluded (binder-shadow territory of the station scanner). Unmarked `<=` comparisons are NOT covered here (scope-ambiguous) - see cure7 for the %-marked form.
patterns.v31_lineage: cure31_A_qleT_face_wash - red-face verbatim: W45 abl_dtpt_dep_supply 'two Theorem conclusion positions on Qle (stdlib Q order Prop face)'; W50 LW3JointFill lw384_qsum0_abs_nonneg; W27 station ledger 'canonical wash Qle -> QleT''; recurrence W27/W29/W45/W47/W50 (>=4 seats).
patterns.idempotence_note: Post-cure faces contain QleT', which the face_exclude guard skips on every later run.

patterns.title: Qle scoped-notation downshift (X <= Y%Q -> QleT' (X) Y%Q in statement faces)
patterns.canonical_note: The %Q-scope mark makes the comparison deterministically Q-domain: canonical patched form keeps the scope mark on the literal operand (QleT' (Qabs x) 2%Q). Multi-token operands are parenthesized. Comparisons WITHOUT a scope mark are scope-ambiguous (Q vs nat vs Z) and are intentionally not covered - they remain scanner-station territory. Nested-parenthesis operand forms exceed the flat-operand trigger (documented blind-spot family of regex cures).
patterns.v31_lineage: cure31_A_qleT_face_wash - red-face verbatim: W45 abl_dtpt_dep_supply patch 'Qabs x <= 2%Q (L123 conclusion)' -> 'QleT' (Qabs x) 2%Q'; W27 station ledger P5_le family.
patterns.idempotence_note: Post-cure faces carry QleT' (excluded) and no `<=` before %Q remains; the trigger cannot re-match.

patterns.title: Qlt statement-face downshift (bare Qlt -> QltT in statement faces)
patterns.canonical_note: Structurally symmetric to cure6 for the strict order: the Set-carrier face is QltT (QltT_to_Qlt carries two explicit _ args). Same guards: QleT'/QltT-carrying faces excluded, binders/names guarded, Definition/Fixpoint excluded.
patterns.v31_lineage: cure31_A_qleT_face_wash - canonical wash trio verbatim (W27 station ledger): 'Qle -> QleT' / Qlt -> QltT / == -> QeqT'.
patterns.idempotence_note: Post-cure faces contain QltT, which the face_exclude guard skips.

patterns.title: Qlt scoped-notation downshift (X < Y%Q -> QltT (X) Y%Q in statement faces)
patterns.canonical_note: Strict-order twin of cure7: the < character must not be the head of <= (negative lookahead), the %Q mark pins the domain, the mark is retained on the literal operand.
patterns.v31_lineage: cure31_A_qleT_face_wash - Qlt/QltT isomorphism named in the proposal canonical anchors (QltT_to_Qlt _ _, two explicit args).
patterns.idempotence_note: Post-cure faces carry QltT (excluded) and no `<` before %Q remains.

patterns.title: refl bridge opener (apply Qle_refl. -> apply Qle_to_QleT'. apply Qle_refl. in proofs of QleT'-face statements)
patterns.canonical_note: After a statement face is washed to QleT', the stdlib reflexivity closer no longer applies directly: the proof must first cross the canonical bridge Qle_to_QleT' (S02_CauchyComplete), then close on the Qle face. When the consuming environment does not re-export the bridge, use the fully-qualified form apply S02_CauchyComplete.Qle_to_QleT'. (REQNOEXPORT family). Fires only inside proofs of statements whose face carries QleT'; other faces keep their proof text untouched.
patterns.v31_lineage: cure31_A_qleT_face_wash - red-face verbatim: W45 abl_dtpt_dep_supply patch 'apply Qle_refl.' -> 'apply Qle_to_QleT'. apply Qle_refl.' (S02:115 canonical bridge, Arch_PA_02:842 precedent form); W47 hand_wash 'apply S02_CauchyComplete.Qle_to_QleT''.
patterns.idempotence_note: The cured text has the opener directly before apply Qle_refl.; the fixed-width lookbehind blocks any re-match.

patterns.title: Import-shadow cure, variant (a): delete the shadowing Import line (Import RealInterfaceEnhancedMod.)
patterns.canonical_note: A bare req/log/exp_neg/exp_neg_pos/opp statement resolves, under Import RealInterfaceEnhancedMod, to class-field projections; the compiled statement stores the projection face and leaks Obj.magic at extraction. Variant (a) removes the shadowing Import line so bare names resolve to the global direct face. Mutually exclusive with cure12 (variant b) - the pack marks both with exclusive_group "import-shadow": running both in one pass fails loud; pick one via --only. Re-adding any Requires the file actually needs is supply wiring, not a cure-pattern concern.
patterns.v31_lineage: cure31_B_import_shadow_direct_face - red-face verbatim: W45 'L81 Import RealInterfaceEnhancedMod. shadows: the statement word-form req (log (exp_neg u) (exp_neg_pos u)) (opp u) resolves to class-field projections (REPL Print pre-wash), root statement stores a real_eq face -> type-synonym cast Obj.magic x1'; recurrence W45+W47 on the same file (main md5 cbb7a78d).
patterns.idempotence_note: The line is gone after the first pass; the trigger cannot re-match.

patterns.title: Import-shadow cure, variant (b): qualify shadowed projections to the global direct face (bare req/log/exp_neg/exp_neg_pos/opp -> fully-qualified real_eq/real_log/...)
patterns.canonical_note: Variant (b) keeps the Import and rewrites the statement face to the global direct forms the extraction expects: req -> S02_CauchyComplete.real_eq, opp -> S02_CauchyComplete.real_opp, log -> S07_RealSetoidExpLog.real_log, exp_neg -> S07_RealSetoidExpLog.real_exp_neg, exp_neg_pos -> S07_RealSetoidExpLog.real_exp_neg_pos. Fires only when the shadowing Import is present (file_include); qualified references are never re-matched; Definition/Fixpoint faces are excluded (local binder shadowing is station-scanner territory). Mutually exclusive with cure11 via exclusive_group. Binder names spelled like the shadowed tokens (e.g. u) are outside the token map and survive verbatim.
patterns.v31_lineage: cure31_B_import_shadow_direct_face - red-face verbatim: W47 hand_wash 'the statement face is rewritten to the fully-qualified direct forms (S02_CauchyComplete.real_eq / S07_RealSetoidExpLog.real_log / real_exp_neg / real_exp_neg_pos / S02_CauchyComplete.real_opp), binder u kept verbatim; extraction-gate magic 1 -> 0 (G3 control: root statement alone extracts magic=0)'.
patterns.idempotence_note: Post-cure faces carry only the dotted global forms; the bare-token trigger (built longest-first from the map) cannot re-match, and the negative lookbehind never touches dotted references.

patterns.title: nat-le premise lift ((X <= Y)%nat -> S01_BaseRing.NatLe (X) Y in statement faces)
patterns.canonical_note: A premise on nat <= is a Prop face; the Set-carrier face is NatLe := Id (Nat.leb n m) true. The lift is the premise-side complement of cure5 (which consumes NatLe hypotheses at nat <= goals). The fully-qualified carrier name is canonical: bare NatLe does not resolve through non-transitive Require chains (REQNOEXPORT family - qualify, do not add Import lines). Multi-token operands are parenthesized; the scope mark is dropped with the parens. Faces already carrying NatLe (cured faces, NatLe_drop/NatLe_lift bridge faces) are excluded.
patterns.v31_lineage: cure31_C_natle_premise_lift - red-face verbatim: W45/W47 abl_audit_base_v7 patch '(gnPrf f pf <= k)%nat -> (L146 premise)' -> 'S01_BaseRing.NatLe (gnPrf f pf) k ->'; W47 hand_wash 'nat-le premise -> S01_BaseRing.NatLe (Id (Nat.leb n m) true, S01:88) - Section 12.2(5) canonical'; recurrence W45+W47 (same file, main md5 5f098369).
patterns.idempotence_note: Post-cure faces carry NatLe (excluded) and no `)%nat` comparison remains.

patterns.title: nat-le supply drop-wrap (exact (f ... H). -> exact (f ... (S01_BaseRing.NatLe_drop _ _ H)). in proofs of NatLe-face statements)
patterns.canonical_note: When the premise is lifted to NatLe (cure13) but the consumed lemma still expects a nat <= proof, the hypothesis crosses the bridge at the consumption point: exact (f ... (S01_BaseRing.NatLe_drop _ _ H)). The wrap assumes the final argument is the hypothesis that must cross the face - review matches before --apply (the applier is dry-run first). Flat-argument applications only; nested-parenthesis argument lists exceed the trigger (documented blind-spot family).
patterns.v31_lineage: cure31_C_natle_premise_lift - red-face verbatim: W45 abl_audit_base_v7 patch 'exact (gnPrf_replay f pf k Hk).' -> 'exact (gnPrf_replay f pf k (S01_BaseRing.NatLe_drop _ _ Hk)).' (S01:91 bridge); W47 hand_wash 'in-proof apply S01_BaseRing.NatLe_drop in Hk as the forward bridge, original exact untouched' (qualified-name variant of the same bridge).
patterns.idempotence_note: The cured call has the bridge wrapping inside the exact; the flat-argument trigger cannot re-match (the inner '(' blocks the call group).

patterns.title: S07 parameterized-shell drop (argument-less Class RealInterfaceEnhancedSetoid applied to a carrier -> bare Class)
patterns.canonical_note: The -Set lineage world carries the interface Class zero-parameter: applying it to a carrier raises 'Illegal application (Non-functional construction): The expression "RealInterfaceEnhancedSetoid" of type "Type" cannot be applied to the term "R" : "Set"'. The mechanical shell drop removes the carrier argument at type-annotation and statement-binder stations (': RealInterfaceEnhancedSetoid Real :=', '{RIS : RealInterfaceEnhancedSetoid R}'). The binding_right_exclude ':=' guard keeps :=-binding right sides untouched while type annotations on the same line survive. The full binder-PAIR removal (dropping '(R : Set)'/'{RIS : ...}' together with the intros lines and call-site argument pairs) touches proof bodies and is NOT a safe single-regex rewrite - it is the manual surgery the binder-shell station reports. Parameterized worlds where the Class genuinely takes the carrier must not run this pattern (dry-run first, --only selection).
patterns.v32_lineage: S07 param_shell_drop - red-face verbatim: UpAblD1S17_UpReqDpoLoss.v:30 'Illegal application (Non-functional construction)' at ': RealInterfaceEnhancedSetoid Real :='; UpAblT6_UpSigMigrate.v:58 / UpAblT6_UpSigMigrate2.v:59 '{RIS : RealInterfaceEnhancedSetoid R}' binder pair; recurrence = 3 files in the W65 wave (cross-seat: W36 cluster-1 ledger 13 files with the same red). Cured precedents: md5 303781ca / 57422928 / e59d97b5; canonical anchor UpReqSumD.v L58/L68-72 (world's own precedent, noted in the cured file heads).
patterns.idempotence_note: After the drop the Class name is no longer followed by a carrier identifier (only ':', ')', ',', ':=' or '.'), so the trigger cannot re-match; the :=-binding-right negative keeps its station on every later run.

patterns.title: S07 notation rebind (insert 'Notation R := Real.' after the last world import)
patterns.canonical_note: After the shell drop the carrier is fixed by the world: the canonical rebind is the single notation line 'Notation R := Real.' placed after the last Require/Import line and before the first use (UpReqSumD.v L58 precedent, mirrored verbatim in all three cured W65 files). The applier's line-insert engine places the line after the last top-level Require/Import line; the file_include gate (the interface Class name) scopes the insertion to the lineage that needs it, and the require_token_regex gate demands an actual bare-R use position. The rebind assumes the world exports Real upstream - a file defining its own carrier must not run this pattern. Interaction guard: the rebind shadows any bare projection named R downstream (the cure32_C' qualified-bridge family is the counter-cure when a supply chain brings its own 'Notation R := Real').
patterns.v32_lineage: S07 notation_rebind - cured lines verbatim: UpAblD1S17_UpReqDpoLoss.v:46, UpAblT6_UpSigMigrate.v:52, UpAblT6_UpSigMigrate2.v:52 all carry 'Notation R := Real.'; canonical anchor UpReqSumD.v L58; recurrence = 3 files in the W65 wave.
patterns.idempotence_note: When the notation line is already present the insertion is skipped (count 0); the inserted line never triggers a second insertion.

patterns.title: S07 projection-bridge bare form (@field Real instance args -> field args through the global instance)
patterns.canonical_note: The source face applies class-field projections with the explicit carrier and instance ('@one_pos Real uabd1s17_ren'); in the argument-less world the fields resolve bare through the global instance RealEnhancedReal (UpReqSumD.v L68-72), so the '@<field> Real <instance>' prefix is dropped and the remaining arguments stay. Fires in statement faces AND proof regions (the supply certificates apply the bridges inside their proofs). The field list is the projection family named in the field report; other worlds must not run this pattern (dry-run first). Record-CONSTRUCTOR argument positions ('MkRecord Real inst slot ...' without @) are binder-surgery territory and intentionally out of scope.
patterns.v32_lineage: S07 projection_bridge_bare (a) - red-face verbatim: UpAblD1S17_UpReqDpoLoss.v base 'lt zero (@Z_align_req Real uabd1s17_ren unit ...)' / '(@one_pos Real uabd1s17_ren)' (8 field names, ~13 stations); cured md5 303781ca rewrites every station to the bare form; world probe first-hand: w65_probe_sigs '@one_pos : RIES -> real_lt zero one'.
patterns.idempotence_note: Post-cure the fields are bare (no '@field Real instance' prefix remains), so the trigger cannot re-match.

patterns.title: S07 predicate-face convergence (bare lt/req -> real_lt/real_eq in statement faces)
patterns.canonical_note: The source statement face carries the projection-face predicates lt/req; the world's direct faces are real_lt/real_eq (UpReqSumD.v L113-114). EXTRACTION-NAME-CONVERGENCE DISCIPLINE (normative, mechanical consequence at the extraction gate): the replacement name must be the SAME constant name the consuming supply lemma's conclusion carries - two delta-equivalent faces with different constant names compile green but insert Obj.magic at every application position during extraction (the W65 arc: emc_3 FAIL magic_ml=3 -> statement face renamed to the supply lemma's own constant -> emc_3c PASS magic 0/0). Picking any delta-equivalent synonym is forbidden. Scoped to the lineage by file_include; multi-token/dotted references are never touched (word-boundary guards); review before --apply (a file legitimately using bare lt for another order would be rewritten - the gate is the Class reference, not the token semantics).
patterns.v32_lineage: S07 projection_bridge_bare (b) - red-face verbatim: UpAblT6_UpSigMigrate.v:60 '(forall s : S, req (f s) (g s)) -> req (sumd_sumf S enum f) (sumd_sumf S enum g)' (6 stations x 2 files); UpAblD1S17 'lt zero beta' binder faces; convergence arc first-hand: logs emc_3 FAIL magic_ml=3 -> emc_3c PASS 0/0 (T6_1), canonical UpReqSumD.v L113-114.
patterns.idempotence_note: Post-cure faces carry only real_lt/real_eq (the lookbehind blocks them as bare lt/req), so the token-map trigger cannot re-match.

patterns.title: S07 binder-shell station (report-only: argumented Class binders awaiting the manual binder surgery)
patterns.canonical_note: Report-only station (engine station-report, mode report): counts the argumented Class binders ('(RIS : RealInterfaceEnhancedSetoid carrier)' / '{RIS : ... carrier}') whose removal is binder surgery - the pair '(R : Set)'/'{RIS : ...}' goes away together with the intros names and call-site argument pairs (the W65 record form also monomorphises the abstract Set slots to the supplied instance, which is a semantic narrowing and stays manual). The engine never rewrites; the dry-run report surfaces the count and the count assertion is: after the surgery the count returns to zero. Candidates still below the promotion bar (each reproduced once, honest note, not counted in the trigger): the qualified-projection bridge 'Let R := @S01_BaseRing.R (@RI_base RI).' (UpAblT5 cured md5 7f09e776, anchor InvPosLtCompat.v) and the Set-slot monomorphise (D1S17 emc_1 FAIL magic 3 -> emc_1c PASS 0/0).

patterns.title: NatLe -> nat <= supply bridge (NatLe_drop, two explicit _ args)
patterns.canonical_note: NatLe and nat <= are different faces; a NatLe-face hypothesis consumed at a nat <= goal goes through exact (NatLe_drop _ _ H). The reverse direction is NatLe_lift. Bare exact/lia across the two faces is forbidden.
patterns.context: only fires when the enclosing statement face contains NatLe and the hypothesis name is not already wrapped
patterns.idempotence_note: Post-cure text has exact (NatLe_drop _ _ H); the bare-form trigger no longer matches.

patterns.title: E3 generic-interface instantiation -> specialization-shim use (abstract-carrier application stations rewritten to the concrete-carrier shim call)
patterns.canonical_note: The consumer stations of a generic supply lemma carry the explicit abstract-carrier application form ('gstep Real natIF x' / '@gstep Real natIF x'): the generic lemma's parameters carry abstract types, and at extraction each application rides the polymorphic face (the CI #178 gate7 whole-tree census shape, LW3 four-module family). The mechanical cure rewrites every abstract-carrier application station to the specialization shim call ('gstep_spec x'), the concrete-carrier intermediate Definition inserted by cure34_E3_spec_shim. The shim's own body keeps the abstract application it specializes (that is the canonical specialization form), so this pattern face-excludes 'gstep_spec' - otherwise a second pack pass would rewrite the shim's own body into a self-call and break the idempotence contract. Scope 'all': stations live in statement faces AND proof regions. The miniature extraction-clean world (fixture Cure34E23World) demonstrates the arc end to end; world-side accessor magic of a defect-generation world is the entity-repair workflow's territory and is not reachable by a consumer-side text cure (documented in the fixture world header).
patterns.v34_lineage: CI #178 gate7 whole-tree census (20261104): LW3ETranscendental 1 / LW3CountEBound 6 / LW3KLegProbe 4 / LW3KnzValue 3 Obj.magic - work-ticket verdict E3 generic-interface instantiation (generic lemma parameters carry abstract types, extraction turns each application into a per-parameter cast); prescription = concrete-carrier intermediate Definition specialization. Gold-standard fixed forms: _wt93_fixmagic/_wt93_reverse ConstructiveWorld_Live LW3 family (statement faces restated on Set carriers, QeqT/Id bridge forms).
patterns.idempotence_note: Post-cure no abstract-carrier application station remains outside the shim's own face, and the shim's face carries gstep_spec (excluded), so the trigger cannot re-match.

patterns.title: E3 specialization shim generation (concrete-carrier intermediate Definition inserted after the last import)
patterns.canonical_note: The concrete-carrier intermediate Definition is the E3 prescription's deliverable: 'Definition gstep_spec (x : Real) : Real := gstep Real natIF x.' restates the generic supply lemma at the concrete carrier behind a monomorphic Set face, so the consumer's stations extract as concrete calls instead of abstract-carrier applications. The line-insert engine places the line after the last top-level Require/Import anchor and before the first use; the file_include gate (the generic supply lemma's name) scopes the insertion to the lineage that instantiates the generic. Run order: AFTER cure34_E3_use_station_spec in the pack list - on the first pass the stations are rewritten first, so the inserted shim body keeps the abstract application verbatim, and no require_token_regex gate is needed (the station form is gone from the text by insertion time). Empirical anchor (Rocq 9.1, fixture world): the shim user's station extracts monomorphic ('let ufx_nat n = gstep_spec n', magic 0/0); a shim that delegates to an abstract-face original ('Definition s : unit := mzero.') inherits the world-side cast ('Obj.magic mzero') - the shim must restate the concrete-carrier application, which is exactly the form this pattern inserts.
patterns.v34_lineage: CI #178 gate7 whole-tree census (20261104): UpAblMetaWindow 13 Obj.magic with the born-clean landing record claiming magic=0 (landing self-check vs CI divergence); LW3 four-module family verdict E3; prescription = concrete-carrier intermediate Definition specialization (work-ticket 20261104). Gold-standard fixed forms: _wt93_fixmagic/_wt93_reverse ConstructiveWorld_Live LW3 family.
patterns.insert_line: Definition gstep_spec (x : Real) : Real := gstep Real natIF x.
patterns.idempotence_note: When the shim line is already present the insertion is skipped (count 0); the inserted line is itself the idempotence anchor of the pair.

patterns.title: E2 record polymorphic field -> explicit-type-annotated middleware (un-annotated field-consumption Definition restated with explicit binder and return annotations)
patterns.canonical_note: A consumer Definition that consumes a record's polymorphic field without an explicit type annotation lets the carrier be inferred from the field's polymorphic type, and the extracted face stays polymorphic ('val unann : 'a1 -> 'a1'); the E2 prescription restates the consumption as an explicit-type-annotated middleware Definition ('Definition unann (n : nat) : nat := wf theW nat n.'), pinning the carrier at the consumer face. The gold-standard fixed form carries exactly this shape (UpAblMetaWindow cured: 'Definition mwi_step (K : bool -> bool -> Real) (mu : bool -> Real) (s' : bool) : Real := ...' / 'Definition mwi_Kunif (s s' : bool) : Real := mtw_half.'). Annotation does NOT clear a defect-generation world's accessor cast (the field projection 'wf' of the miniature world still extracts with 'Obj.magic w.wf __ x' - that is world-generation debt owned by the entity-repair workflow); what the annotation mechanically guarantees is the consumer face: pre-cure the extracted signature is polymorphic, post-cure it is 'val unann : nat -> nat' (asserted in the test arc on the extracted .mli). Review before --apply: the trigger is the canonical un-annotated face 'Definition unann := wf theW.' - a file consuming a different definition named wf must not run this pattern (the gate is the record reference, not the token semantics).
patterns.v34_lineage: UpAblMetaWindow born-clean landing (commit 4f2006f record claims magic=0) vs CI #178 gate7 census 13 Obj.magic - landing self-check vs CI divergence (fake-green incident); work-ticket verdict E2 record polymorphic field exact, prescription = explicit-type-annotated intermediate Definition. Gold-standard fixed forms: _wt93_fixmagic/_wt93_reverse ConstructiveWorld_Live UpAblMetaWindow.v (mwi_step/mwi_Kunif annotated middleware, md5 ec7cb774).
patterns.template: Definition unann (n : nat) : nat := wf theW nat n.
patterns.idempotence_note: Post-cure the face carries '(n : nat) : nat :=' between the name and ':=', so the trigger (which requires the bare 'Definition unann :=' head) cannot re-match.

patterns.title: E2 middleware arity adaptation (downstream carrier-application stations follow the annotated face)
patterns.canonical_note: The annotated middleware face 'Definition unann (n : nat) : nat := wf theW nat n.' takes one binder where the un-annotated polymorphic face took a carrier argument ('unann nat n'); every downstream application station follows ('unann n'). Scope 'all': stations live in statement faces AND proof regions. Fires only on the 'unann nat <ident>' application shape; the annotated face itself contains 'unann (n : nat)' which the word-boundary guard never matches, and the middleware body 'wf theW nat n' carries no 'unann' token.
patterns.v34_lineage: Same E2 lineage as cure34_E2_field_annot (the UpAblMetaWindow cured form consumes the middleware by its own name at every station); fixture-arc first-hand: pre-fix 'Definition use_unann (n : nat) : nat := unann nat n.' -> post-cure ':= unann n.'.
patterns.idempotence_note: Post-cure no 'unann nat <ident>' application remains: the middleware face and body never carry that shape, and downstream stations are one-argument calls.

patterns.title: E2 un-annotated field-consumption station (report-only: definitions awaiting the middleware restatement)
patterns.canonical_note: Report-only station (engine station-report, mode report): counts the un-annotated record-field-consumption definitions ('Definition <name> := wf theW.') across statement faces. The engine never rewrites; the dry-run report surfaces the count and the count assertion is: after the middleware restatement (cure34_E2_field_annot) the count returns to zero.
